source_snapshot.title: UAE vegetable prices fall by up to 42% as local farm produce reaches shelves
source_snapshot.text: Dubai: Vegetable markets have begun to record declines in the prices of a number of items. The trend comes with the start of the local agricultural season and the introduction of Emirati crops to sales outlets, which has boosted supply and contributed to a decrease in price limits for some vegetables by about 42%, in addition to offering extensive deals on other items. The decline was observed in the price limits of certain vegetables at retail outlets, most notably zucchini; its displayed price reached Dh6.95 per kilogram, compared to a previous price of Dh12, a decrease of 42%. Meanwhile, the price for green pepper varieties reached about Dh9 per kilogram, compared to a previous price that of Dh11, with a decrease of about 18%. The price of cucumbers also decreased to Dh4 per kilogram, compared to Dh6 previously, a decrease of 33%, while the price of eggplant reached about Dh6.95 dirhams per kilogram, compared to Dh7.95 previously, a decrease of 12.6%. The outlets witnessed various offers, most notably on varieties of tomatoes, potatoes and lemons. The downward trend in prices comes with the start of the local agricultural season and the introduction of Emirati crops to sales outlets. File photograph Vegetable traders and suppliers said that the introduction of varieties of local seasonal vegetables has raised the levels of price competition and given consumers wider choices at more competitive prices. It has also contributed to lowering the prices of a variety of vegetables available in the market, which previously relied more heavily on products supplied from foreign markets. This, in turn, has provided greater options with lower prices for consumers, supported an increase in supply in the markets, and led to greater discounts on vegetables. The outlets pointed out that the local supply will increase even more during December 2026 and January 2027, which will enhance price reductions and offers. The CEO of NRTC Group, which supplies vegetables and fruits, Muhammad Nassar Al-Rifai, said that “the introduction of varieties from the local agricultural season supported the decline in price limits for varieties traded in the markets, and supported the introduction of different price offers in sales outlets.” He stressed that “the increasing supply of local agricultural produce will support market stability and lower price limits, especially during the peak of local vegetable production in January,” noting that “local agricultural produce, with the diversity of supply from different markets, enhances the abundance of supply and stabilises price limits for different types of vegetables in the markets.” CEO of NRTC Group Muhammad Nassar Al-Rifai said that “the introduction of varieties from the local agricultural season supported the decline in price limits." Picture credit: Supplied Issa Najib Al-Khoury, CEO of Mirak Food and Vegetable Supply Company, said that “the markets have recently witnessed the introduction of varieties of vegetables from the local agricultural season, which in turn has contributed to reducing the price limits of the varieties of vegetables available in the markets, and raising the levels of offers offered in the sales outlets.” He explained that “the introduction of local agricultural season products is still in its early stages, and the introduction processes will gradually increase at higher rates, especially during December 2026 and January 2027, which in turn will enhance the availability of low prices for various vegetables and increase the rates of offers on them.” Vegetable trader Mohammed Aziz said: “The markets are witnessing a decrease in the prices of currently available vegetable varieties with the start of introducing local agricultural season products into the markets, which has made available varieties with lower price limits compared to previous periods that relied more on products supplied from foreign markets, and therefore the options were limited, and prices were determined by the countries of origin and according to the cost of shipping and transportation and operational variables.” He added: “The supply of locally grown vegetables is expected to increase in the coming weeks in the markets, and more so compared to last year, as a number of local farms move to increase production and offer it through sales outlets via supply contracts.” Vegetable trader Muhammad Qasim pointed out that “the introduction of new varieties from the agricultural season during the recent period has had a positive impact on the markets through the decline in the price limits of the vegetables available in general in the markets compared to previous periods, which was evident through basic vegetable varieties such as cucumbers and zucchini.” He explained that “the increased supply of vegetables in the markets following the introduction of local varieties has raised the rates of offers on vegetable prices, and reduced the price limits for the types of vegetables available in the markets.”

source_verification.reason: All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.

claims.claim: Prices on vegetables in the UAE fell by up to 42%.
With the start of the local agricultural season in the UAE, prices on a number of vegetables decreased.
Zucchini prices fell from 12 to 6.95 dirhams per kilogram, a 42% decrease.
Prices also decreased for green pepper, cucumbers, and eggplants.
Local farm produce increased supply in the market and expanded choices for buyers.
Price decreases are expected to continue in December 2026 and January 2027.

title: UAE vegetable prices fall by up to 42% as local farm produce reaches shelves
summary_ru: 🚜 Цены на овощи в ОАЭ упали до 42% 💰 С началом местного сельскохозяйственного сезона в ОАЭ цены на ряд овощей снизились. Например, кабачки подешевели с 12 до 6,95 дирхамов за килограмм, что составляет снижение на 42%. 📅 Также снизились цены на зелёный перец, огурцы и баклажаны. Местные фермерские продукты увеличили предложение на рынке и расширили выбор для покупателей. Ожидается, что в декабре 2026 и январе 2027 года снижение цен продолжится.
